title: LOADng parsers allow self-loop (originator == destination)
description: Rreq::from_bytes and Rrep::from_bytes validate addresses for unspecified/loopback/multicast but do not reject messages where originator == destination. Self-loop RREQs are semantically invalid and waste network bandwidth. Add validation: `if originator == destination { return Err(LoadngError::SelfLoop) }`
